requirements.general: SPM or IGCSE O-Level or equivalent with at least 3 subjects with grade "C" or above Note: Any changes to the MQA Program Standard/Professional Body Requirements/Recommendations will apply to new cohort students only. Implementation of the eligibility requirements in accordance with the MQA Professional Program/Professional Body Requirements/Recommendations is applicable in accordance with the provisions set forth in the Malaysian Qualifications Agency circular (MQA) when enforcing the application of a MQA Professional Program or Professional Body Requirements. English Proficiency Requirements (International Students):  IELTS: 5.0 or its equivalent If a student does not meet this requirement, HEPs must offer English proficiency courses to ensure that the student’s proficiency is sufficient to meet the needs of the program.
